input.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 (branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: a run's launch config carries grading_enabled, off when missing, through the ordered launch delivery (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts). T2: settlement of an evaluation execution is fenced to the exact current claim, and completion appends its observation in one transaction (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts, observation/src/grading/worker.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #791 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #791, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2 locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/worker.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.

body.summary: No blocking or ambiguous requirement was found. The target ref and PR metadata currently agree on commit db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef. At that commit T1 defaults grading_enabled to false and delivers the committed config with launch input; T2 locks and rechecks the exact claim and commits execution completion plus the grade observation in one transaction. Three procedural warnings should be corrected before planning: pin the SHA, collect T1-relevant test evidence, and make dependency installation explicitly compatible with a clean tracked worktree.

findings.description: T1 matches the target model: RunConfig names grading_enabled, parseRunConfig defaults an absent value to false, rejects non-booleans, and returns the normalized value (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:7-10,21-41).

T1 matches launch mapping: the launched event reads its committed run config, rejects malformed committed config, and emits the exact config beside input (oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:42-48). Focused repository tests also cover defaulting, exact mapping, ordered drain, and replay (oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83; oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts:50-65; oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts:177-209).

The builder command bun run --filter observation test exercises T2 but not the oakridge-dbos tests that establish T1. As written, the assessor must cite builder test output for each finding even though the required output cannot directly validate T1. Add focused T1 test execution, with an unavailable database-backed test reported as a known issue rather than fabricated evidence.

PR #791 and the local remote-tracking ref currently agree on db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef, but checkout by branch name alone does not guarantee the same commit later. Require HEAD equality with that PR head SHA before tests and artifact publication.

The specification both permits bun install if needed and prohibits file edits. Since the repository has a committed bun.lock, clarify that only ignored dependency files may be populated, require a frozen lockfile install, and require the tracked worktree to remain clean.

T2 exact-claim fencing is present: the store locks the execution row first, then rechecks status, owner, attempt, and database-time lease, and fences the authoritative update again (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:194-227). The worker passes the same ExecutionClaim through request marking and completion/failure settlement (observation/src/grading/worker.ts:71-90).

T2 atomic completion is present: completeExecution performs the fenced execution update, provider-attempt update, and grade_observation insert inside one withTenant settlement transaction (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:248-292). Tests cover expired, reclaimed, lock-wait-expired, and duplicate completion claims (observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:304-357,360-379).
